fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/Homepage/LatestModelsByCategory.cy.js#Homepage - LatestModelsByCategory [en] TC-LMC-05: one Check Offers lead from E Rickshaw tab submits successfully
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-LMC-05
**Title:** One Check Offers lead from E Rickshaw tab submits successfully
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the E Rickshaw tab in Latest Models by Category, click Check Offers once, fill name/mobile/city, enter a 5-digit price/budget only if asked, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission from that tab.

**Steps:**
1. Open Latest Models by Category
2. Open the E Rickshaw tab
3. Click Check Offers on one visible card
4. Fill name, mobile and city (and 5-digit price/budget if shown)
5. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
